subject: general
question: A man borrowed money and paid back in two equal amount installments of Rs. 1,089, at 10% compound interest compounded annually for 2 years. What was the sum (in Rs.) borrowed?
solution:
Given: 

Installment = Rs. 1089

Rate of Interest = 10%

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the borrowed be Rs. P.

According to the question,

P (1 + 10 /100)² = 1089 (1 + 10/100)¹ + 1089

⇒ P = 2286.9 ÷ 1.21

⇒ P = 1890

**∴ Rs. 1890 was borrowed.**
